description: Returns a team's roster for a season, one row per player with an evidenceId: name, NTRP rating, wins, losses, matches and Desk level. Call it when someone asks who is on a team, or before you state a fact about a roster. Pass `season` when the person named a year, because without it the answer covers the current season. If `moreRows` is true, call again with a larger `limit`, up to 60.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks about prior years / all history.

limit.description: Max roster rows to return (default 30 = the full roster, max 60). Omit to get the whole team.

season.description: Optional season year to filter to, e.g. 2026

team.description: Team name or partial name to resolve. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: query_roster
title: A team's roster and ratings
